breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)² + τ_avg²), incorporating both the normal stress and shear stress contributions. It does not repeat the flawed instruction to use only the transverse shear stress as the maximum in-plane shear. The calculation explicitly shows both terms (8.335² + 1.67²), matching the ground truth approach.
